_comment: Accepted scan findings (AIGSEC-007). One entry per advisory id and scanner, with a reason and an expiry date at most 180 days ahead; expired entries stop applying. See docs/operations/security-scanning.md, 'Blocking policy'. Example entry: {"id": "CVE-0000-00000", "scanner": "trivy", "reason": "why it cannot be fixed yet and why it is not exploitable here", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
